abilities.desc: Fire a shard of ice (5 damage) that chills and stacks Frostbite. Frozen hits fill Frost, the meter under your abilities. At 100 Frost your shard becomes a piercing Glacial Lance (11 damage).
abilities.variants: Level: a piercing shard (a fan of three with Hailstorm). Up: Icicle Rain, icicles fall onto the area you look at after a warning. Down: Frost Step, dash back and leave an ice decoy that explodes.

abilities.desc: Raise a wall of solid ice that blocks enemies and projectiles, then melts after 8 s.
abilities.variants: Level: a wall of ice ahead of you. Up: Glacier Ram, a moving wall that bulldozes forward and slams enemies. Down: Frozen Bastion, a ring of ice pillars around you and Resistance II.

abilities.desc: Release a burst of frost that freezes everything around you solid.
abilities.variants: Level: an instant 6-block nova. Up: leap and crash down in a bigger 8-block nova. Down: Glacial Implosion, a collapsing ring drags enemies in for 1 s, then freezes them solid.

abilities.desc: Call a blizzard that slows, chills and freezes enemies while ice spikes erupt beneath them.
abilities.variants: Level: a 10-block blizzard where you stand. Up: Eye of the Storm, a tighter blizzard that travels with you. Down: Shatterpoint, freeze everything within 12 blocks solid, then shatter them all at once for 12 damage.

p1d: You never freeze in powder snow, and water freezes into ice beneath your feet.
p2d: Melee hits stack Frostbite. At 5 stacks the target freezes solid.
awd: Frozen enemies shatter when your abilities hit them and take 40% more damage.
